sprint.name: Authentication: Passkeys, Recovery and a Real Captain Role
sprint.goal: Replace username-and-password-only login with passkeys as the default, keep passwords as an optional fallback for people who cannot use a passkey, give administrators and server operators a safe way to invite and recover accounts without email, and make the captain role grant real, limited access.
focus_areas: Passkeys by default; passwords as an optional per-user fallback
Account recovery without email: single-use links from the admin UI or the command line
Captain role enforced on routes - everything except users, settings and backups
Session and login hardening, then an independent security review
